confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors rest mainly on Numbeo Belgrade averages (updated 2 Oct 2026; an Aug 2026 snapshot ran about 10% lower), the strongest part of the estimate. Cocktail and wine_glass are less certain because direct per-bar and per-glass data were weak. Hostel and hotel anchors are low confidence: sources conflict (dorm averages about 16 to 30 USD, hostel private about 41 to 44 USD, 3-star about 62 to 76 USD), most are undated or not July-specific, and July seasonality is unclear. No October euro rate was found, so the EUR/USD assumption is approximate. The RBA rate comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rate table, not a directly opened page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used; the basis is Belgrade-specific data. Local prices were converted at about 102.4 RSD per USD (about 117.3 RSD per EUR and EUR/USD about 1.145 for July 2026). The wine glass is inferred from the local draught beer price (about 1.15x), and the cocktail is a Belgrade club price reduced to bar level.
